name: DSIP
description: DSIP (delta sleep-inducing peptide) is a synthetic nonapeptide used in laboratory research. Published studies have examined its interactions with sleep-related and neuroendocrine signalling pathways in experimental models. Supplied for in vitro and other laboratory research only.

name: Epitalon
description: Epitalon (also written epithalon) is a synthetic tetrapeptide (Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly) used in laboratory research. Literature describes it as an analogue of epithalamin and reports experimental work on telomerase-related and pineal-associated pathways in non-clinical models. Supplied for laboratory research only.

name: BACTERIAL WATER
description: Bacteriostatic water is sterile water containing 0.9% benzyl alcohol as a bacteriostatic agent. It is supplied as a laboratory solvent for reconstituting lyophilised research compounds. Not a medicine and not for injection or other use in humans or animals.

name: MELANOTAN 2
description: Melanotan II is a synthetic cyclic analogue of α-melanocyte-stimulating hormone. In research literature it is described as an agonist at melanocortin receptors (including MC1R and MC4R) and is used to study pigmentation and melanocortin signalling in experimental systems. Supplied for laboratory research only.

name: BPC-157
description: BPC-157 is a synthetic pentadecapeptide sequence derived from a portion of body protection compound studied in gastric juice. Laboratory literature describes experimental work on angiogenesis, nitric oxide signalling, and tissue-response pathways in non-clinical models. Supplied for laboratory research only.

name: RETATRUTIDE
description: Retatrutide is a synthetic peptide investigated in published research as a triple agonist of the GLP-1, GIP, and glucagon receptors. It is supplied here as a research chemical for laboratory study of incretin and glucagon receptor pharmacology. It is not a licensed medicine and is not supplied for any therapeutic use.

name: GHK-CU
description: GHK-Cu (glycyl-L-histidyl-L-lysine copper complex) is a copper-binding tripeptide first identified in human plasma and used in laboratory research. Experimental literature examines its interactions with copper-dependent and gene-expression pathways in cell and tissue models. Supplied for laboratory research only.

name: CJC/IPAMORELIN
description: This item is a research blend of CJC-1295 (a GHRH analogue) and ipamorelin (a ghrelin-receptor / GHS-R1a agonist). Each component is studied separately in laboratory literature for effects on growth-hormone secretagogue signalling in experimental models. Supplied for laboratory research only.

name: SLU-PP-322
description: SLU-PP-332 is a small-molecule research compound described in published literature as an agonist of estrogen-related receptors (ERRα/β/γ). Experimental work has examined mitochondrial and oxidative-metabolism pathways in laboratory models. Supplied for laboratory research only. (Catalogue name: SLU-PP-322.)

name: NAD+
description: NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) is a dinucleotide cofactor used in laboratory research on redox biochemistry, sirtuin-related pathways, and mitochondrial metabolism in experimental systems. Supplied as a research chemical, not as a dietary supplement or medicine.

name: TB-1
description: TB-1 is listed as a research peptide. Supplier naming for this designation is not standardised; the specific sequence and identity should be confirmed against the batch documentation before experimental use. No composition, purity, or activity claim is published on this page. Supplied for laboratory research only.

name: BPC-157/TB-500 BLEND
description: This item is a research blend of BPC-157 (a synthetic pentadecapeptide) and TB-500 (a synthetic fragment related to thymosin beta-4). Each peptide is studied in laboratory literature on cytoskeletal and tissue-response pathways in experimental models. Supplied for laboratory research only.

name: Kisspeptin
description: Kisspeptin (typically kisspeptin-10 or related fragments, depending on the batch) is a peptide ligand of the GPR54/KISS1R receptor. Laboratory research uses it to study GnRH-related and hypothalamic–pituitary signalling in experimental systems. Supplied for laboratory research only.

name: IPAMORELIN
description: Ipamorelin is a synthetic pentapeptide described in research literature as a selective agonist of the ghrelin receptor (GHS-R1a). It is used in laboratory studies of growth-hormone secretagogue signalling. Supplied for laboratory research only.

name: TB4
description: Thymosin beta-4 (TB4) is a naturally occurring 43-amino-acid peptide. Laboratory literature describes its role in actin sequestration (G-actin binding) and related cytoskeletal pathways in experimental models. Supplied for laboratory research only.

name: GHK-1200
description: This listing is a topical research formulation containing GHK (copper tripeptide chelate), sodium hyaluronate, panthenol, and astaxanthin as labelled by the supplier. It is presented for laboratory and formulation research. It is not a cosmetic medicine and is not offered as a treatment or skin-care outcome product.

name: CJC-1295
description: CJC-1295 is a synthetic analogue of growth hormone-releasing hormone (GHRH). Research literature distinguishes DAC and non-DAC forms; confirm the form against the vial label and any available batch documentation. Used in laboratory studies of GHRH-receptor signalling. Supplied for laboratory research only.

name: IGF-1
description: IGF-1 (insulin-like growth factor 1) is a peptide hormone used in laboratory research on IGF-1 receptor (IGF1R) signalling, cell growth pathways, and related experimental models. Supplied for laboratory research only. Not a medicine.

name: SS-31
description: SS-31 (elamipretide) is a mitochondria-targeted tetrapeptide used in laboratory research. Published experimental work examines its association with cardiolipin and mitochondrial membranes in non-clinical models. Supplied for laboratory research only.

name: KPV
description: KPV is a tripeptide (Lys-Pro-Val) C-terminal fragment of α-MSH. Laboratory research has examined melanocortin-related and inflammatory-signalling pathways in cell and animal models. Supplied for laboratory research only.

name: GLOW
description: GLOW is a branded multi-peptide research blend. Composition can vary by supplier; confirm constituents and amounts against the vial label and any available batch documentation before use. No clinical or cosmetic outcome is claimed. Supplied for laboratory research only.

name: KLOW
description: KLOW is a branded multi-peptide research blend. Exact ingredients and concentrations are supplier-dependent and are not independently verified on this page. Confirm identity against batch documentation. Supplied for laboratory research only.

name: PT-141
description: PT-141 (bremelanotide) is a synthetic cyclic peptide and melanocortin-receptor agonist, with published research focused on MC3R/MC4R pharmacology. It is supplied as a research chemical for laboratory study of melanocortin signalling. It is not supplied as a medicine.

name: SELANK
description: Selank is a synthetic heptapeptide analogue of tuftsin used in laboratory research. Literature describes experimental work on GABAergic and related neuropeptide signalling in non-clinical models. Supplied for laboratory research only.

name: MOTS-C
description: MOTS-c is a mitochondrial-derived peptide encoded in the mitochondrial genome. Laboratory studies have examined AMPK-related and metabolic-signalling pathways in experimental models. Supplied for laboratory research only.

name: Semax
description: Semax is a synthetic peptide analogue of an ACTH(4–10) fragment used in laboratory research. Experimental literature examines melanocortin-related and neurotrophic signalling in non-clinical models. Supplied for laboratory research only.

name: HMG
description: HMG (human menopausal gonadotropin) is a preparation containing follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH) and luteinizing hormone (LH) activity. It is supplied here for laboratory research on gonadotropin receptor signalling. It is not supplied for fertility treatment or any clinical use.

name: HCG
description: hCG (human chorionic gonadotropin) is a glycoprotein hormone that acts at the LH/hCG receptor. It is supplied for laboratory research on gonadotropin signalling. It is not supplied for medical, fertility, or other human use.

name: TESAMORELIN
description: Tesamorelin is a synthetic analogue of growth hormone-releasing hormone (GHRH). In published research it is described as a GHRH-receptor agonist used to study GH-axis signalling. It is a prescription medicine in some jurisdictions for specific indications; this listing is a research chemical for laboratory use only and is not a dispensed medicine.

name: TB-500
description: TB-500 is a synthetic peptide corresponding to an active fragment of thymosin beta-4 (often the 17–23 region, LKKTETQ, depending on the preparation). Laboratory research uses related sequences to study actin-binding and cytoskeletal pathways. Confirm the exact sequence against batch documentation. Supplied for laboratory research only.
